name: Slav Defense
description: Defend the d5 pawn with …c6, keeping the c8 bishop free to develop.

lines.name: Main Line (5.a4 Bf5)

notes.3: …c6 supports d5 without blocking the c8 bishop, unlike …e6.
notes.7: …dxc4 takes the pawn when White can't easily win it back with tempo.
notes.13: …Bb4 pins the c3 knight and stops White's e4 push.

lines.summary: Take on c4, develop the bishop to f5 before …e6, then pin with …Bb4.

lines.name: Exchange (3.cxd5)

notes.5: …cxd5 keeps a symmetrical, very solid pawn structure.
notes.9: …Nc6 develops and adds a defender to d4 and e5.

lines.summary: Symmetry is fine for Black: develop knights and bishop actively, then …e6.

lines.name: Quiet 4.e3

notes.7: …Bf5: White's e3 shut in their own bishop, so Black gets this bishop out at once.
notes.11: …Bg6 keeps the bishop; Black is happy to recapture towards the centre.
notes.13: …hxg6 opens the h-file for Black's rook and gives a solid pawn structure.

lines.summary: Against 4.e3, play …Bf5 at once; if White's knight chases it, recapture with …hxg6.

lines.name: Main Line: 9.Qe2

notes.17: …Nbd7 prepares for e4 by covering e5.
notes.19: …Bg6 steps back from the pawn's attack, still eyeing e4.
notes.21: …Bh5 pins the f3 knight, so White's e5 push leaves d4 weaker.

lines.summary: When White pushes e4, retreat the bishop to g6 and then pin with …Bh5.

lines.name: Exchange: 8.Qb3

notes.15: …Bb4 counters the queen's attack on b7 by pinning the c3 knight.
notes.17: …O-O: Black lets White take on c6 and recaptures with the b-pawn.

lines.summary: Against Qb3 and Bb5, pin with …Bb4 and castle; the position stays balanced.

lines.name: Krause (6.Ne5)

notes.11: …Nbd7 challenges the e5 knight right away.
notes.15: …e5 frees Black's game in the centre.

lines.summary: Against 6.Ne5, challenge the knight with …Nbd7, then free your game with …Qc7 and …e5.

lines.name: 5.e3 b5

notes.9: …b5 holds the extra c4 pawn for now.
notes.11: …b4 kicks the knight to a poor square on the rim.

lines.summary: When White plays slowly with 5.e3, hold the pawn with …b5, then kick the knight with …b4.
